# Summon_LinkChildCall — 0x54F245

<!-- Generated by tools/reference.py. -->

通常戦闘の召喚 0x54E7B0 内の 0x5774A0(parent, child) 呼び出し。このとき召喚に使ったスキルが呼び出し元の [esp+0x44]（呼ばれた側の [esp+0x50]）にある。スキルのデータの先頭 +0x00 はキー名の std::string。

The only appender is `0x5774A0(parent, child)` (stdcall, `ret 8`), which also overwrites child `+0x1E594` with parent only when that field is already nonzero. Exactly three E8 callers, each right after a summon spawn: `0x54F245` (normal summon `0x54E7B0`, child from `0x56F880`), `0x5479F0` (simple-battle summon `0x547490`, child from `0x544290`), `0x5537BF` (simple-battle missile summon `0x553390`). No writer shrinks `+0x17C`; dead children stay in the vector and are told apart by child `+0x1867C`. Earlier note: dev_lab story ON-STAND-010 already identified the vector, `0x5774A0`, `0x575A60` and `0x5445E0`; the new part is the complete caller set, the absence of removal and the absence of a reverse pointer.
